This limits the spatial precision of the stimulation and makes it particularly difficult to understand speech in the presence of background noise.

titulo: Molecular imaging reveals how shape-shifting protein complex captures DNA and holds separate sections together
resumo: Researchers at Kanazawa University and the National Institute of Genetics in Japan have used high-speed atomic force microscopy to observe how a group of proteins known as Smc5/6 interacts with DNA. That patch apparently never reached some users, meaning the Paint app remains unpatched and vulnerable. This was reported by Windows Latest , who checked the version of the Paint app on their system. It corresponded to the version number prior to the security patch (in this case 11.2603.251.0) and not the recommended patched version (which should be 11.2609.401.0). Some antivirus software apparently flagged Paint as unpatched, and some users and administrators noticed that their version of Paint had apparently not been updated. It’s still unclear whether the fault lies in the distribution of the update or in Paint itself. Both Windows Latest and other affected users had automatic updates correctly enabled in their settings. titulo: My AI agents sent emails without my OK. This simple prompt stops it
resumo: All she wanted was help from ChatGPT with her proposal, but soil hydrology researcher Ying Zhao got a lot more than she bargained for. Asking for more maps and metadata about her project—landscape restoration on the Loess Plateau in China—Zhao kept messaging “please continue” to ChatGPT for additional details. Only later did she realize that ChatGPT had taken her cue and run with it, emailing fellow researchers about her project and (politely) requesting assistance. “The responses that I received to the emails were helpful,” wrote Zhao, recounting her experience on Nature.com . “The information that I was given in these emails allowed me to advance the project. But the useful outcomes of ChatGPT’s behavior do not negate the fact that the actions it took were unauthorized.” That’s the thing about AI agents: The very qualities that make them so powerful, including initiative and persistence, also make them unpredictable and liable to doing a lot more than you anticipated. I’ve written before about how AI agents like ChatGPT Work, Claude Cowork, Gemini Spark, and others don’t just need prompts but outcomes . More importantly, they also require boundaries: specifics on what not to do.
